description: Defines an abstract base class 'FormatInfo' in the 'MigraDoc.Rendering' namespace that provides properties for formatting state information used during rendering operations.

classes.name: FormatInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for formatting information received by calling Format() on a renderer.

methods.name: IsStarting
methods.description: Indicates that the formatted object is starting.

methods.name: IsEnding
methods.description: Indicates that the formatted object is ending.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Indicates that the formatted object is complete.

methods.name: StartingIsComplete
methods.description: Indicates that the starting of the element is completed.

methods.name: EndingIsComplete
methods.description: Indicates that the ending of the element is completed.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the formatted object is empty.
